section.name: Tomcat 8.0.18 Released
section.p: The Apache Tomcat Project is proud to announce the release of version 8.0.18 of Apache Tomcat. Apache Tomcat 8.0.18 includes a numerous fixes for issues identified in 8.0.17 as well as a number of other enhancements and changes. The notable changes since 8.0.17 include:

ul.li: A regression that caused response truncation when using forwarding (57475) has been fixed.
Various improvements to ReplicatedMap in Tribes.

section.p: Full details of these changes, and all the other changes, are available in the Tomcat 8 changelog.

section.name: Tomcat 8.0.17 Released
section.p: The Apache Tomcat Project is proud to announce the release of version 8.0.17 of Apache Tomcat. Apache Tomcat 8.0.17 includes numerous fixes for issues identified in 8.0.15 as well as a number of other enhancements and changes. The notable changes since 8.0.15 include:

ul.li: Fixing a regression in annotation scanning introduced in 8.0.15
The RemoteAddrValve and RemoteHostValve can now optionally include the port when filtering along with a new option to trigger authentication rather than denying access
Various edge cases fixes in WebSocket

section.p: Warning: The following notable bug was found in 8.0.17: 57476: some HTTP responses may be truncated. The team works on preparing the next release (8.0.18) to address this issue.
Full details of these changes, and all the other changes, are available in the Tomcat 8 changelog.
